QUOTE: If the standard functions are not available, the default is the `platform_calloc_uninit` stub in `platform.c:25-30`, which always returns NULL. Until a real allocator is installed, every allocation fails.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes only the calloc stub returning NULL, and it never says the uninitialised free does nothing. It also ties the stub to the case where the standard functions are unavailable, not to the pointers' defaults in general.
